requested_by: user, 2026-11-20: 'si le VIX monte de plus de x % sur les y derniers jours alors on coupe z jours' for the MNQ part of the book
hypothesis: After a sharp rise of the VIX, the MNQ sleeves of the active book (S01 18-model ATR vote, S02 volatility breakout, S03 compression breakout) perform worse than usual, so switching them off for a few sessions improves the risk-adjusted return of the MNQ sub-book. Expected sign: higher daily Sharpe with the overlay than without.
disclosure_before_freeze: Seen before the freeze (audit_20261115 phase 8, full history incl. the reused validation): Sharpe of the book by tercile of MNQ ATR% J-1 is 2.51 / 1.10 / 1.82 (low / mid / high); S01 1.73 / 1.06 / 0.94, S02 1.37 / 0.54 / 0.70, S03 -0.28 / 0.04 / 1.29. ATR% is a level, not a change, but it is correlated with the VIX.

Seen: book_aggregation_risk_r1_20261112 rejected a size modulated by instrument volatility (IS cash +50 % but P(XFA lost) +7.2 points) and left open only a size that decreases when volatility rises. This overlay is of that kind.
Before the freeze the assistant told the user it expected a small loss of PnL and probably a failure of the gates.
No PnL of any VIX rule on these sleeves was computed before the freeze. The VIX files were only opened to read their first and last lines.

The validation window 2024-01-02 -> 2026-03-19 was used to select the sleeves' vote clusters, never for this overlay; the EXT window 2026-03-20 -> 2026-10-02 was read for the sleeves (replay and S01 one-shot).

data.daily_pnl: audit_20261115/outputs/daily_pnl_union.csv columns S01, S02, S03 (S01 = 18-model ATR vote), MNQ sessions = rows where S02 is not empty, 2019-05-06 -> 2026-03-19
data.vix: data/raw/vix-cboe.csv (CBOE daily VIX, 1990-01-02 -> 2026-10-07), close column; cross-checked against data/raw/vix-daily.csv on the overlap
data.book_check: research/locked_eight_sleeve_portfolio_20261115/daily_pnl.csv (sum of the three MNQ columns must equal the audit panel on the common sessions)

rule.signal: rise(t) = VIX close(t) / VIX close(t - y) - 1, t and t - y counted in VIX trading days
rule.timing: for an MNQ session on date d, the information is the VIX close of the last VIX trading day strictly before d (known at about 16:15 New York the day before)
rule.action: the three MNQ sleeves are flat (daily PnL = 0) on the next z MNQ sessions after t; a new trigger during a cut extends it to z sessions after the new trigger
rule.unchanged: signals, sizes and costs of the sleeves; MGC and MBT sleeves untouched

metric: daily Sharpe of the MNQ sub-book S01 + S02 + S03 in USD, x sqrt(252), MNQ sessions of the window, days without trade and cut days at 0
selection_IS_only: plateau score of a cell = median IS Sharpe of the cell and its existing neighbours at +/- 1 step on each axis (up to 27 cells); the selected cell maximises the plateau score; ties: fewer cut sessions, then smaller z, then larger x

technical_gates.T1: vix-cboe.csv and vix-daily.csv closes agree on their overlap (abs gap <= 0.01)
technical_gates.T2: S01 + S02 + S03 of the audit panel equals the sum of the three MNQ columns of the 2026-11-15 lock on every common session (abs gap <= 1e-6)
technical_gates.T3: every MNQ session has a VIX close strictly before it within 5 calendar days

IS_gates_selected_cell.G1: IS Sharpe(cell) - IS Sharpe(no overlay) >= 0.10, and plateau score > IS Sharpe(no overlay)
IS_gates_selected_cell.G2: PBO of the 100 cells + no overlay (CSCV, 10 contiguous blocks, Sharpe) <= 0.40
IS_gates_selected_cell.G3: paired stationary bootstrap of the IS Sharpe difference (mean block 20, 5 000 draws, seed 20261120): P(difference > 0) >= 0.90
IS_gates_selected_cell.G4: share of IS MNQ sessions cut <= 20 %, and IS net PnL >= 85 % of the no-overlay PnL

one_shot_VAL_if_IS_passes.guard: results/validation.json is written once; a second run is refused
one_shot_VAL_if_IS_passes.V2: VAL net PnL >= 85 % of the no-overlay PnL
one_shot_VAL_if_IS_passes.information: EXT 2026-03-20 -> 2026-10-02 with and without the overlay; effect on the 8-sleeve book (union calendar) on VAL; worst day, max drawdown, days below -500 and -1 000 USD of the MNQ sub-book

information_IS_always: full 100-cell table (IS only), cut share, PnL, max drawdown, worst day, days below -500 USD; the cut sessions of the selected cell

verdicts.CLOSED_IS: the selected cell fails any of G1-G4; VAL is not read
verdicts.REJECTED_VAL: IS passes, V1 or V2 fails
verdicts.CANDIDATE_SHADOW: IS and VAL pass: the overlay is tracked in shadow on the forward; adopting it is a separate versioned user decision

no_rescue_rule: No grid value, threshold, window or metric is changed after any result is read.
